indexable_storable: Yes, counts and categories are facts; pages are indexable and the data may be stored
acquisition_path: OpenStreetMap. Self host Overpass from a Geofabrik .osm.pbf extract, or pace Overpass runs over hours. The repo already holds a PARTIAL capture (13 of 44 cities) stopped by the public instance rate limiter, not by licence. Free. ODbL needs attribution and share alike on a derived database
Same national statistical offices, city level CPI or price level series where published. Numbeo is refused on licence
OpenStreetMap route relations (route=hiking, route=bicycle) via the same Overpass or Geofabrik path, plus NASA POWER for seasonality. Free
National statistical offices publish city or region level earnings: Destatis Verdienststrukturerhebung, INSEE, ISTAT, ONS ASHE (which is city level and free), e-Stat Japan, IBGE Brazil

indexable_storable: Yes for hotel pages, with live pricing rather than stored pricing
acquisition_path: Booking.com and Expedia affiliate APIs, Hotellook/Travelpayouts for aggregated inventory. Revenue share rather than a fee. Terms permit price and availability display with a tracked link; deep caching is usually limited to 24 hours and republishing the whole inventory is forbidden

Eurostat is country level. City level: national statistical offices (Destatis, INSEE, ISTAT, INE, CBS, GUS) publish city rent indices unevenly, and several national portals publish official rent mirrors (Germany Mietspiegel per city, Netherlands huurcommissie). Commercial alternative is a property portal partnership

National school and university registers (UK Get Information About Schools is a free bulk download, Germany per Land, Italy MIUR). For international schools, the accrediting bodies publish member lists. OSM amenity=school for location
National health system pages and EU cross border healthcare directives. For facilities, national hospital registers (NHS in the UK is an open dataset, Germany Krankenhausverzeichnis)

Per airport: the operator pages for the airport express, bus and taxi, plus GTFS where the operator publishes it. Roughly 20 to 30 minutes per airport, so 40 to 60 hours for the 120 airports that carry the measured demand
Land registries publish transaction prices: UK HM Land Registry Price Paid is a free bulk download, Netherlands Kadaster, France DVF is open. Coverage is uneven outside these
National police and statistics crime series (UK police.uk is open and geocoded, Germany PKS, Netherlands CBS). Crowd sourced perception indices are refused on licence

GTFS feeds cover schedules for most metro and bus operators and many include fare_attributes; the gaps are filled by the operator fare page, which is a published fact. Mobility Database and Transitland aggregate GTFS feeds with their licences listed
OSM tourism=* plus Wikidata/Wikipedia for descriptions (CC0 and CC BY SA). Wikivoyage is CC BY SA and covers attractions per city. Free
No open item level price aggregate; Numbeo refused on licence. Eurostat HICP item indices give relative change, not absolute prices, which supports an index page and not a price list
Government service pages plus Wikidata for the structured facts. Free
Destination government immigration pages, plus IATA Timatic for the commercial version. Government pages are free and citable; Timatic is a paid feed

Meetup, Eventbrite and Facebook groups are excluded by standing instruction and none offers a listing feed whose terms permit republishing. The only lawful substitute is official city and library event calendars, which is the events path rather than a community path
OECD tax database is free and structured; national tax authorities publish rates and brackets. Open to read, not to redistribute whole, so derive rather than mirror
National banking regulators for account opening rules; bank fee comparison needs either manual capture or a comparison partner
Destination government publications on working hours, leave, notice and permits. EURES for the EU. Free to read, citable as fact
FCDO, US State Department, Auswaertiges Amt and equivalents publish structured travel advice; FCDO has a machine readable feed under the Open Government Licence
